documentation.file_docstring:
Health Check Endpoints for K8s Readiness/Liveness Probes

Thread-safe health checker with configurable component checks,
JSON-serializable reports, and aggregate status computation.
inline_comments: Preserve check-reported latency if non-zero, else use measured.
member_docstrings: HealthStatus: Possible health states for a component or the overall system.
ComponentHealth: Health result for a single component.
HealthReport: Aggregate health report for all registered components.

HealthChecker: Thread-safe health checker with pluggable component checks.

Args:
    version:
is_healthy: True when aggregate status is HEALTHY.
is_ready: True when the system is ready to serve (not UNHEALTHY).
register_check: Register a named health check function (thread-safe).
check_health: Run **all** registered checks and return a full report.
check_ready: Readiness probe — same as full health check.
